title: AUTALIC: A Dataset for Anti-AUTistic Ableist Language In Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs and baseline models on a novel classification dataset (AUTALIC) of context-aware Reddit sentences to detect anti-autistic ableist language. The evaluation compares model F1 scores and human-model agreement (Cohen's Kappa) using zero-shot and in-context learning prompts with varying terminology (person-first vs. identity-first language).
